log.note: Today's FE hero at the signal quality bar, built on the recalibrated electrical/electronics profile. Infineon = world #1 auto/power-semiconductor maker (~$17.2B rev, ~$120B cap), SiC leader. REAL in-car workstream: FE powertrains are manufacturer-developed, so SiC sits in Jaguar's traction inverter (the biggest lever on efficiency/thermal/regen) - not a halo. Verified decision PATH: CMO Andreas Urschitz -> CEO Jochen Hanebeck -> Automotive President Peter Schiefer. Screen-outs done: Eaton (FE-relevant eMobility being spun off/declining -> F1 fit), Porsche (TDK+Synopsys occupy electronics), Mahindra (Renesas). Jaguar power-semi lane OPEN. Gate 0 blockers, 2 pages. (Electra 68 + Watershed 70 + Vertiv 82/F1 also generated this day as bench options.)

log.note: Fri F1 hero. Cadence = computational-engineering leader; just acquired Hexagon's CFD/multiphysics/structural stack (MSC Nastran, Adams) - the literal toolchain F1 cars are designed with. REAL MODE-A workstream; greenfield Cadillac builds its CAE from zero (PRIME LANE). Decision path: SVP Mktg/BD Nimish Modi -> CEO Anirudh Devgan. 0 blockers, 2pp.

log.name: Divergent Technologies
log.note: Sat F1 hero, replacing ElevenLabs (screened out — already_present: official Audi Revolut F1 AI partner since Jan 2026, the exact workstream pitched; the already_present gate is run FIRST now). Divergent = $2.3B AI additive-manufacturing leader ($290M Series E at $2.3B, Sep 2025; DAPS platform). REAL MODE-A workstream: AI-designed, 3D-printed lightweight structural components (suspension wishbones/uprights) under the cost cap — already PROVEN, as Divergent prints exactly these for the McLaren W1 hypercar. Grid-check run first: that tie is with McLaren AUTOMOTIVE (road cars), a SEPARATE company from McLaren Racing (F1) — so Divergent is grid-clean for F1, and the road-car work is an honest warm brand-family bridge, not an existing F1 deal. Additive-manufacturing lane on McLaren reads OPEN (0 conflicts/0 crowding). Decision-maker CEO Lukas Czinger. 0 blockers, 2pp, HOT 78.

log.name: Niron Magnetics
log.note: Mon FE hero — a NET-NEW company sourced from scratch (MD direction), after a disk-level audit showed the eligible FE bench is exhausted: of 19 eligible FE prospects only Ørsted was never rendered, and it was already rejected. (GE Vernova and Redwood both rolled back this session as repeats — each had a prior bench render on disk, not just the log.) Niron Magnetics = rare-earth-free permanent-magnet leader (Clean Earth Magnet, iron-nitride; UMN-origin). Capital+identity inflection: ~$214M raised, reportedly raising ~$500M at ~$2-3B (Axios Mar 2026), world's-first commercial-scale iron-nitride plant (1,500 t/yr) online 2026; backers GM/Stellantis/Volvo. REAL MODE-A workstream: the permanent magnet is the heart of the PM synchronous motor FE manufacturers build, and Niron already integrates into EV motors (MATTER variable-flux motor, Jan 2026). Sharp why-now: China's rare-earth export-control crisis. HONEST: race-motor adoption is a multi-year co-engineering commitment (not off-the-shelf), so scored 75 HOT (urgency 13, ops_fit 15) — not inflated. All facts verified live; reported ~$2-3B raise flagged as reported/in-process, not closed. Nissan EV-tech/motor-materials lane OPEN (gridfit confirmed). Decision-maker CEO Jonathan Rowntree. 0 blockers, 2pp.

Real MODE-A workstream: generative world-models for driver-in-loop simulation + synthetic strategy data. FULL DISCIPLINE applied + committed verification memo (odyssey-verification.md): already-sent check (log+disk = net-new); every fact re-verified live; CAUGHT + CORRECTED a prior-session fabrication (record listed NVIDIA as an investor — not in the round; syndicate is Natural Capital/Amazon/AMD/GV/EQT/In-Q-Tel, compute on AWS+AMD); conflict-check re-pointed team Williams->Alpine (Williams's AI partner is Anthropic, covering strategy+sim; also screened out CoreWeave as already_present-Aston). Alpine has NO incumbent AI/sim partner -> PRIME LANE, no conflict. HONEST WARM 72: early research lab (capacity 14), frontier workstream, crowded F1 AI lane. Decision-maker CEO Oliver Cameron. 0 blockers, 2pp.
